scripts.android: export CAP_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=${CAP_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-$(sed -n 's/^NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=//p' ../../../web/surfaces/app/.env.local)} && export CAP_SERVER_URL=${CAP_SERVER_URL:-http://localhost:3002} && pnpm www && cap sync android && pnpm android:run
scripts.android:run: cd android && ./gradlew -q installDebug && for p in 3000 3002 8787; do adb reverse tcp:$p tcp:$p; done && adb shell am start -n $(node -p "require('../shell.json').appId")/.MainActivity
scripts.ios: export CAP_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=${CAP_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-$(sed -n 's/^NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=//p' ../../../web/surfaces/app/.env.local)} && export CAP_SERVER_URL=${CAP_SERVER_URL:-http://localhost:3002} && pnpm www && cap sync ios && pnpm ios:run
scripts.ios:run: cd ios/App && xcodebuild -quiet -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination "id=$(xcrun simctl list devices booted | grep -oE '[0-9A-F-]{36}' | head -1)" -derivedDataPath ../DerivedData build && xcrun simctl install booted ../DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/App.app && xcrun simctl launch booted $(node -p "require('../../shell.json').appId") && open -a DeviceHub
